EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for attending our “Global Digital Payments in Education” Webinar!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Thank you for attending our “Global Digital Payments in Education” webinar. We hope we gave you a good look into the payment preferences and behaviour in the top international student markets and how Flywire has built solutions to overcome these payment challenges.
Here are links to the webinar recording <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/webinar-recording-global-digital-payments-in-education?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> and slideshow presentation <https://more.flywire.com/rs/372-QSQ-649/images/Flywire_Education_Webinar_Global_Digital_Payments_in_Education_July_2020_Slides.pdf>.
A special shoutout to our speakers:
- Sean Yue, Global Payments Manager, APAC
- Devon Wong , Director of Client Relationship Management, APAC - Wesley Ng, Business Development Manager, APAC
Have questions? Just reply to this email and we'll connect you with someone who can help. If you'd like to learn more about Flywire, please visit edu.flywire.com <[[https://www.flywire.com/industries/education/payments]]>.
